description: SEC dividend safety score — Dividend safety score (0-100) for any US-listed company from its own 10-K XBRL data: free-cash-flow payout (latest and 3-year), earnings payout, net debt/EBITDA, interest coverage, dividend-per-share streak and 5-year growth, cuts (stock-split artifacts detected from share counts), falling free cash flow. Verdict VERY_SAFE/SAFE/BORDERLINE/UNSAFE/VERY_UNSAFE or NO_DIVIDEND, with strengths, flags and a 6-year history. Banks/insurers/REITs are scored without FCF tests. Not investment advice. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_dividend_safety
